source: 1cm-square checkerboard grid (8x5 internal corners), diagonal baseline (opposite corners, 7x4 squares), sub-pixel corner detection, 2026-09-14. Supersedes the earlier hand-clicked two-point calibration (38.0mm assumed distance); this diagonal-baseline measurement agrees with the old value to ~0.4% (0.3709 vs 0.3725 mm/px), so the old calibration was not a real error source, but this is derived from many more samples (67 corner-to-corner spacings cross-checked) and a single long baseline, which is less sensitive to sub-pixel corner-detection noise than the original short two-point click.
